snippet.title: [New Game] Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest - Rebellion Soul PV
snippet.description:
The first-ever game adaptation of "Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest", titled "Arifureta: Rebellion Soul", is now available on the G123 platform!
Train Hajime Nagumo, the world's strongest Synergist, transmute powerful Artifacts, and embark on an exciting fantasy RPG adventure as you face new enemies!

Start the game here：https://s.g123.jp/j2n0p7qj

Experience the World of Arifureta in Your Browser!

■About the game
Title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest - Rebellion Soul
Genre: Fantasy RPG
Price: Free (in-game purchases available)

#ArifuretaGame #ARIFURETA #G123
